historical_phenomenon: Early Old English nonhigh open-medial syncope after light and heavy roots, distinct from the existing high-vowel and later pre-l phases.
conditioning: Preferred bounded K core: short unstressed nonhigh vowel in an open posttonic syllable before a heavy final syllable; positive-primary root protection, no lexical or case condition.
executable_implementation: Immutable native attempt03 compares production, coverage, no-proxy, C, G, H, K and J. K retains SC063/065/066/040 and OELHWeakRaising.
selected_input_assumptions: Independently supported proposed pairings: find2011 *fúnðanai/fundne; west2282 *wéstą/west; hammer2053 *xámaraz/hamer; soul2201 *sáiwalǭ/sāwle. Complete cell morphology and notation limits are explicit in README.md.
firing_census: K changes exactly find, hammer, soul and west in both unchanged selected391 and original380. Complete transitions and deltas are archived; no baseline is replaced.
positive_witnesses: Full compositional masculine nominative plural *fúnðanai -> fundne, Strunk1904 pp.15,82
Full independently reconstructed nominative *xámaraz -> hamer, Wright-Wulcker1884 I272.36
Full neuter base *wéstą -> west, Orel459 plus Fulk2018 §7.8 and Orosius attestation
Full inherited accusative *sáiwalǭ -> sāwle, verified Skeat1874 Luke12:20
Independent full *fágenas -> fæġnes and *þéudanas -> þēodnes; adjective accusatives
Marked-prefix and longer-posttonic stage controls, explicitly not attested reconstructions

negative_controls.name: K stressed-root, long/closed medial and light-final stage negatives
Full summer, water, over retained-vowel controls
World, earthly, rainbow and unchanged high-vowel selected histories
No new whole-model global functionality claim

counterfactual_results: C misses light-root full fæġnes and internal/prefixed locality; G/H can delete a marked primary root; K protects it. J violates light-final retention. Complete accusative find probe remains unsuccessful; directional long ending gives westne, short probe is rejected. Genuine parser failures01/02 are preserved.
literature_support: Hogg1992 §§6.14–18; Fulk2010/2022 retained source dossier; Fulk2018 §§7.8,9.2,12.30; Luick303; Brunner245,321,366; comparative/attestation sources itemized in the consolidated report. Campbell574.3 is transcription-mediated because held original pages226–227 are missing.
historical_vs_modelling: K is a bounded source-supported nonhigh core, not a complete vowel-loss theory. Early stress context and inherited-ending carriers are implementation abstractions. No new historical chronology edge follows merely from executable order.
